notes.title: Patch Notes Jan. 21
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fix:[/b]

[list]
[*] Shooting accuracy for players client side.
[*] No weapon change on aiming.
[*] Smoothing of floor textures in the building.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Nov. 22
notes.content: Procedural buildings not working, so we rolled back and created a new branch with the procedural on it.

notes.title: Patch Dec. 22
notes.content: Solved procedural buildings not working properly

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov. 22
notes.content:
[h2]New features : [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a second gamemode : [b]Capture The Objective[/b], where you will have to find a Briefcase on the map, and bring it back to the Supply Crate without dying.
[*] Added the procedural system to generate our game map, in order for the building to always be different in every game you will play.
[/list]
